label: exploratory, post hoc
rule: group-A pair with filter-off minimum sampled obstacle clearance closest to the unrounded group-A median; ties by actor index (checkpoint_selection order), density, trial index
stall_onset_convention: first state from which the filter-on centroid stays within 0.05 m of its final position
cover_disc_robot_rule: robot with the smallest obstacle cover barrier at stall onset; ties by robot index
note: geometric selection only; it does not show that this robot or constraint caused the stall, and a centroid stall does not mean every robot stopped
